text: [AA] Paul, an apostle [2] not from human beings nor through a human being but through Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised him from the dead, [AB]
[3] and all the brothers who are with me, to the churches of Galatia:
grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
[4] who gave himself for our sins that he might rescue us from the present evil age in accord with the will of our God and Father, [AC]
to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen. [AD]
[AE] I am amazed that you are so quickly forsaking the one who called you [6] by [the] grace [of Christ] for a different gospel
(not that there is another). But there are some who are disturbing you and wish to pervert the gospel of Christ.
[AF] But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach [to you] a gospel other than the one that we preached to you, let that one be accursed! [7]
As we have said before, and now I say again, if anyone preaches to you a gospel other than the one that you received, let that one be accursed!
[AG] Am I now currying favor with human beings or God? Or am I seeking to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a slave of Christ. [8]
[AH] Now I want you to know, brothers, that the gospel preached by me is not of human origin.
For I did not receive it from a human being, nor was I taught it, but it came through a revelation of Jesus Christ. [10]
[11] For you heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God beyond measure and tried to destroy it, [AI]
and progressed in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries among my race, since I was even more a zealot for my ancestral traditions. [AJ]
But when [God], who from my mother's womb had set me apart and called me through his grace, was pleased [AK]
to reveal his Son to me, [AL] so that I might proclaim him to the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult flesh and blood, [12]
nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me; rather, I went into Arabia [13] and then returned to Damascus.
[14] Then after three years [15] I went up to Jerusalem to confer with Cephas and remained with him for fifteen days. [AM]
But I did not see any other of the apostles, [AN] only James the brother of the Lord. [16]
(As to what I am writing to you, behold, before God, I am not lying.) [AO]
Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia. [AP]
And I was unknown personally to the churches of Judea that are in Christ;
they only kept hearing that "the one who once was persecuting us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy." [AQ]
So they glorified God because of me.
